_about: NeonDrift Ambient: English texts. Same keys as pt-BR.json; {name} = a value filled in by the code.
panel.title: Customize NeonDrift
soft.note: This track has no Spotify analysis — soft ambient mode
soft.noteNA: Spotify analysis unavailable right now — soft ambient mode
wall.err.format: Unsupported format. Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
wall.err.gifBig: GIF too large ({size}). The maximum is 15 MB.
wall.err.imgBig: Image too large ({size}). The maximum is 80 MB.
wall.err.animBig: Animated image too large ({size}). The maximum is 15 MB.
wall.err.open: Couldn't open this picture. It may be damaged or too large.
wall.autoDim: Bright picture: dimmed it by 30% so text stays readable. Adjust it under “Dim”.
wall.pressEnter: Press Enter (or click) to choose a picture from your computer.
toast.match.noColors: This picture has almost no vivid colors: kept the current colors
toast.match.fail: Couldn't read the colors of this picture
overlay.testHint: Move the mouse to go back to the settings
dock.title: Back to the large preview
amb.masterHint.on: Starts after {n} s of no activity while music is playing
amb.masterHint.off: Off: only starts with “Try it now”
ctl.caps.hint: mark the peak and drift down slowly
sb.hint.bars: Intensity: how strongly they react to the bass. Reach: how far the bars go up and down. Fall: how long they take to come back down after each beat.
sb.hint.ring: Intensity: how strongly they react to the bass. Reach: how far the ring's bars extend. Fall: how long they take to pull back after each beat.
sb.hint.wave: Intensity: how strongly they react to the bass. Reach: the height of the waves. Fall: how long they take to settle after each beat.
sb.hint.over200: Above 200%, Intensity mostly makes the beat bigger
sb.hint.over200.maxReach: : to keep the beat from taking over, keep Intensity between 130 and 200%.
sb.hint.over200.raiseReach: : to make everything bigger without the beat taking over, raise Reach and keep Intensity between 130 and 200%.
sb.legend.ring: Crown: bass · Halo: vocals · Dots: highs
sb.legend.bars: Center: bass · Shoulders: vocals · Tips: highs
sb.legend.wave: Ribbon 1: bass · Ribbon 2: vocals · Ribbon 3: highs
sb.reset.isDefault: This style is already at its defaults
sb.reset.title: Resets only this style: Intensity 130%, Reach 60%, Fall 0.7 s (asks for a second click to confirm)
fx.zoom.hint: A light zoom on every beat and a bigger one when the bass kicks in
fx.glow.hint: A soft glow on every beat and a flash when the bass kicks in
fx.groove.hint: The visual sways in time with the music, even between beats
rm.hint: Paused: {os} has animation effects turned off
el.master.hint: Each part of the music lights up a different part of the visual. When an instrument comes in, you see it.
el.rm: Partly paused: {os} has animation effects turned off (nothing travels or spins; the layers still light up with the music)
el.sub.sometimes.tag: react to moments in the music
el.hint.low.ring: the sustained bass (808, bass line) in the crown, between beats
el.hint.low.bars: the sustained bass (808, bass line) in the center bars
el.hint.low.wave: the sustained bass (808, bass line) in the main ribbon
el.hint.voice.ring: the halo around the cover breathes; a glint follows the melody
el.hint.voice.bars: the haze behind the bars and the shoulders
el.hint.air.ring: the outer dots twinkle on every hi-hat
el.hint.entry: a shockwave rushes outward when the bass comes in at the drop (move it to see it in the preview)
el.hint.snare: a quick snap on every snare or clap
el.hint.mood: on a build-up everything tightens and speeds up; in a breakdown everything calms down; at the drop it lets go (move it to see it in the preview)
el.hint.hue.ring: the halo's color shifts slowly with the chords, always within your colors
el.hint.hue.bars: the color of the haze behind the bars shifts slowly with the chords, always within your colors
el.hint.hue.wave: the second ribbon's color shifts slowly with the chords, always within your colors
el.hintRM.entry: at the drop, a ring of light flashes on and off in place
el.hintRM.mood: on a build-up the edges darken; in a breakdown everything calms down; at the drop it lets go
el.reset.isDefault: The layers are already at their defaults
el.reset.title: Resets all layers and reactions to their defaults: everything on, 100%, color follows the harmony (asks for a second click to confirm)
rhythm.hint.beat: Pulses on every beat, like a four-on-the-floor kick (trance, house, electronic).
rhythm.hint.bass: Pulses on the strong bass: 808s, kick drum and bass (trap, baile funk, rap).
rhythm.hint.auto: Picks by itself for each song: every beat for electronic music, the strong bass for trap and baile funk.
rhythm.hint.autoFour: This song: every beat (sounds electronic, four-on-the-floor kick).
rhythm.hint.autoBass: This song: the strong bass (808s, kick drum and bass).
amb.reset.title: Resets everything on this tab (asks for a second click to confirm): style, Intensity / Reach / Fall of all 3 styles, effects, per-element layers, rhythm and start delay. Colors and wallpaper stay as they are.
amb.foot: Move the mouse or press any key to leave ambient mode.
col.swap.title: Swap colors
col.darkWarn: Dark color: buttons and highlights will stand out less.
col.match.hint.off: Picks two vivid colors from the wallpaper
col.match.hint.cover: On: the colors follow each song's cover
col.match.hint.on: On: colors taken from the wallpaper
col.foot: The colors change the accents across all of Spotify and in ambient mode. The navy background stays so everything remains readable; to change the whole mood, change the wallpaper too.
wall.fileInfo.empty: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF (GIF up to 15 MB)
wall.hint.noCover.file: Nothing with a cover is playing right now: showing your picture until the next song.
wall.hint.noCover.default: Nothing with a cover is playing right now: showing the neon gradient until the next song.
wall.hint.cover: The background changes with every song. Use the Blur controls below to soften the cover.
wall.hint.noFile: Couldn't find your saved picture: please choose it again.
wall.hint.file: Your picture is stored on this computer only.
wall.hint.default: A soft neon backdrop drawn by NeonDrift itself.
wall.blurHint.cover: Album cover keeps its own blur settings (default 40 px, very soft).
wall.blurHint.zero: At 0 (Sharp) the picture has no blur at all; dim or blur it if text gets hard to read.
wall.reset.title: Resets the wallpaper, dimming and blur to their defaults (asks for a second click to confirm). Your saved picture stays saved.
wall.blurHint.layout: Layout blur: the background behind Spotify's screens.
wall.blurHint.amb: Ambient mode blur: the full-screen background (preview above, at actual size).
colors.note.noTheme: The NeonDrift theme isn't active: the colors only change ambient mode, this panel and its button.
wall.note.noTheme: The NeonDrift theme isn't active: the wallpaper only shows in ambient mode.
compat.note: This Spotify version ({v}) hasn't been tested with NeonDrift yet. Ambient mode works; some layout details may look different.
compat.note.api: Some Spicetify features NeonDrift uses are missing here. Ambient mode still works (without the track analysis, in soft mode).
toast.shortcut: NeonDrift: press Ctrl+Alt+N to open its settings
overlay.intro: Ambient mode · move the mouse to go back · settings: {where}
overlay.introWhere.top: the equalizer button at the top
overlay.introWhere.playbar: the equalizer button in the player bar
